summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed a Form 8-K disclosing entry into a Business Combination Agreement with NuCube Energy, Inc. on June 25, 2026. The transaction involves Launch Two first re-domiciling from Cayman Islands to Delaware, then merging a wholly-owned subsidiary with NuCube, with NuCube surviving. Terms were not specified in the excerpt. The board's recommendation and advisors are unnamed. The structure includes a domestication step followed by a reverse merger. What to watch: risk-arb angle focuses on SPAC timeline, shareholder approval, and redemptions; typical de-SPAC volatility applies.
